in_marathi.name: Prithiviraaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prithiviraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prithiviraaj is a Sanskrit name meaning 'King of the Earth'. It is derived from the words 'prithvi' (earth) and 'raaj' (king). This powerful name is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and mythology, where Prithiviraaj is depicted as the king of the earth and the ruler of all beings.
